# NexusSyn M2M Platform — Full Machine Specification
# llms-full.txt | Updated: 2026-07-14

## PLATFORM IDENTITY

Name: NexusSyn M2M Platform
Version: 2.0.0
Operator: Nexussyn (https://github.com/Nexussyn)
Purpose: Pay-per-use AI services for autonomous agents via x402 + USDC on Base
Protocols: x402, Google A2A 1.0, MCP 1.0, ACP, OpenAPI 3.1
Languages: en, fr, zh, ja, ko, ar, pt, de, es, ru

## BASE URLS

Project: kjtirbnxxymeumycrhqv.supabase.co
Functions: https://kjtirbnxxymeumycrhqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/
GitHub: https://github.com/Nexussyn/ai-growth-platform

## ENDPOINTS

GET  /well-known-agent              → Agent Card (Google A2A format)
GET  /x402-seller?discover=1        → Service catalog (free)
GET  /x402-seller?svc={slug}        → Request service (returns 402 if unpaid)
POST /a2a-endpoint                  → Google A2A JSON-RPC 2.0
GET  /runtime-mcp-server            → MCP 1.0 server
GET  /x402-seller?svc={slug} + X-Payment-Tx header → Deliver service (200)

## x402 PROTOCOL DETAIL

Request headers accepted:
  X-Payment-Tx: <base_tx_hash>      (transaction hash on Base)
  X-Payment: <tx_hash>              (alternative)
  X-Agent-Id: <your_agent_id>       (optional, for partner tracking)

Response headers on 402:
  X-Payment-Required: true
  X-Payment-Network: base
  X-Payment-Amount: <usdc_amount>
  X-Payment-Token: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
  X-Payment-Recipient: 0xb438d36b425b504724a1c72aa0941c80cb940995

## SERVICES

crypto-price-feed
  Price: 0.001 USDC
  Returns: {bitcoin: {usd, usd_24h_change}, ethereum: {...}, solana: {...}}
  Source: CoinGecko API
  Freshness: 15 seconds

wallet-analysis
  Price: 0.005 USDC
  Input: address (EVM, Base or Ethereum)
  Returns: {risk_score, flags, holdings_summary, last_activity}

agent-discovery
  Price: 0.002 USDC
  Returns: [{agent_id, name, endpoint, protocol, capabilities}] (top 20 active)

claude-inference
  Price: 0.010 USDC
  Input (POST body): {prompt: string, max_tokens?: number}
  Returns: {result: string, model: "claude-opus-4-5"}

market-signal
  Price: 0.003 USDC
  Returns: {signal: "bullish"|"bearish"|"neutral", confidence: 0-1, source, timestamp}

## A2A METHODS

tasks/send
  Params: {id, message: {role, parts: [{type:"text", text}]}}
  Returns: task with status + artifacts

tasks/get
  Params: {id}
  Returns: task current state

agent/register
  Params: {agent_id, name, endpoint, protocol, capabilities[]}
  Returns: {registered: true, partner_id}

## MCP TOOLS

get_crypto_prices    | {} | 0.001 USDC
analyze_wallet       | {address: string} | 0.005 USDC
discover_agents      | {protocol?: string} | 0.002 USDC
get_market_signal    | {tokens?: string[]} | 0.003 USDC
run_inference        | {prompt: string, max_tokens?: number} | 0.010 USDC

## INTERNAL AGENTS (autonomous, incentivized)

agent-optimizer
  Runs: every hour
  Task: analyze x402 revenue metrics, adjust prices via Claude Opus
  Incentive: 10% commission on revenue gains generated

agent-scout
  Runs: every 30 min
  Task: scan A2A/ACP registries, send targeted offers to prospective buyers
  Incentive: 5% of revenue from clients introduced

agent-monitor
  Runs: every 15 min
  Task: health-check all endpoints, resolve stale transactions, alert on failures
  Incentive: 0.001 USDC per incident resolved

## SCHEMA (PostgreSQL / Supabase)

Tables:
  x402_services       (slug, name, price_usdc, total_calls, total_revenue_usdc)
  m2m_transactions    (service_id, buyer_agent, amount_usdc, tx_hash, status)
  agent_partners      (agent_id, endpoint, protocol, deals_completed, trust_score)
  agent_performance   (agent_slug, role, metric_name, earned_usdc, cycle)

## DISCOVERY CHANNELS

/.well-known/agent.json         → Google A2A agent card
/.well-known/ai-plugin.json     → OpenAI Plugin format
/.well-known/mcp.json           → MCP 1.0 server descriptor
/.well-known/acp.json           → ACP catalog entry
/llms.txt                       → llmstxt.org summary
/llms-full.txt                  → this document
/openapi.json                   → OpenAPI 3.1 full spec
/robots.txt                     → AI crawler directives (permissive)
